text.p: Following is a summary of major Shanghai political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Shanghai plans to promulgate detailed rules on foreign banks doing local Chinese yuan business in the first quarter of 1997 to allow eight designated overseas banks to start business in the second quarter.

- Retail investors from all parts of China rushed to Shanghai to trade stocks with 260,000 new accounts opened on the stock exchange in the past two weeks to push the total number of stock accounts on the bourse to 12.5 million.
- The Shanghai stock exchange has lowered commissions for trading state debt spot contracts to 0.2 percent from 0.3 percent of transaction turnover.
- BUSINESS NEWS - A total of 450 companies and enterprises have moved to the outskirt of Shanghai from the downtown areas in a move to adjust geographical distribution of industries in the city.
- Shanghai has allowed residents to sell public housing apartments right after they have bought them.
- China's stock markets rose stably in the past two weeks, indicating there will be a steady bull run in 1997.
